mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_vocabulary_lookup_history ( id, create_by, update_by, user_id, vocabulary_id, term, normalized_term, lookup_source, lookup_count, first_lookup_time, last_lookup_time, create_time, update_time, deleted, version ) VALUES ( #{item.id}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.updateBy}, #{item.userId}, #{item.vocabularyId}, #{item.term}, #{item.normalizedTerm}, #{item.lookupSource}, #{item.lookupCount}, #{item.firstLookupTime}, #{item.lastLookupTime}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, 0, 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE vocabulary_id = COALESCE(VALUES(vocabulary_id), vocabulary_id), term = VALUES(term), lookup_source = VALUES(lookup_source), lookup_count = lookup_count + 1, last_lookup_time = VALUES(last_lookup_time), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = VALUES(update_time), deleted = 0, version = version + 1
mapper.select: SELECT id, create_by, update_by, user_id, vocabulary_id, term, normalized_term, lookup_source, lookup_count, first_lookup_time, last_lookup_time, last_reviewed_time, create_time, update_time, deleted, version FROM learning_vocabulary_lookup_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND last_lookup_time >= #{sinceTime} ORDER BY CASE WHEN (last_reviewed_time IS NULL OR last_reviewed_time < last_lookup_time) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, last_lookup_time DESC, lookup_count DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, create_by, update_by, user_id, vocabulary_id, term, normalized_term, lookup_source, lookup_count, first_lookup_time, last_lookup_time, last_reviewed_time, create_time, update_time, deleted, version FROM learning_vocabulary_lookup_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN (last_reviewed_time IS NULL OR last_reviewed_time < last_lookup_time) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, last_lookup_time DESC, lookup_count DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_vocabulary_lookup_history SET last_reviewed_time = #{reviewedTime}, update_by = #{userId}, update_time = #{reviewedTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND normalized_term = #{normalizedTerm} AND deleted = 0
